verdict.rationale: The product ships an official `npx skills` CLI with documented install, update (`npx skills update`), and subscribe/fork modes, plus an alternate `claude plugins install` route via the Claude Code marketplace — squarely an official CLI for an AI-native workflow (installing/updating agent skills). Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on verification of the CLI's reliability or full command surface (e.g., help text, error handling) beyond first-party docs.
